cause: The match ends mid-flow, not a game unload bug. Around match time 04:48-05:24 the player's side takes the enemy HQ (VICTORY: HQ elimination), match_state.ended is set, World.step returns early (tick frozen), and whichever ramp phase is running stalls. Evidence: .plan/pt_final/cnfac7/cnfac7_ramp_apcout_f6_z1.png (the cnfac7_norepath run, 15:18) shows the VICTORY overlay at 05:24 during the f6_7 unload; my run3 failed f6_7 LOAD instead with 'ticks 0' (sim did not advance in 180 s) and .plan/unload7/shots3/cnfac7_ramp_apcin_f6_z1.png shows VICTORY at 04:48. A headless probe of the f6_7 scene (.plan/unload7/probe.gd) loads and unloads fine (APCs 5.4 tiles behind the tail). The full flow passed 173/0 in a run where the enemy HQ held. Timing-dependent, so it looked like a flake. Not caused by SUITSIM7 _repath_through, PERFSIM7 or PERFFPS7.
fix: tools/pt7_cnfac7.gd only (LF, no CRLF): (1) run() sets w.cfg.victory = 'endless' after join_sim, unless the match has already ended, and logs a new check cnfac7_match_running. The flow tests the facility and ramp, not the win condition. No check or threshold was weakened. (2) Hygiene, NOT the cause: mv.join_sim() added before the unload_all w.submit calls. Every other world write in the flow already joins first.
real_player_paths_checked: No in-game path loses a command. match_view.issue() sends commands to SimRunner.submit, which queues while a step is in flight and submits at join. Checked: dronebay_card._issue and lpreserve_card._issue (both use mv.issue); ops_panel.issue (mv.issue); team_card._submit (hub.issue, then MatchView.issue); drone_input (mv.issue); g2_commands and ui6a_hub (documented MatchView.issue). The direct world.submit calls are match_view._debug_spawn_test (init-time --spawn-test debug, called from view init before stepping), the art probes view5/view6_probe, and the fit_* UI fit tools. All are test/debug only. No game change needed.
